notes: Ask for music, entertainment, or game videos and choose from up to three verified YouTube results with thumbnails and titles.
Click a video or say play first, second, or third. Music searches no longer inherit the game you are playing.
Videos that cannot play inside ScrapLink open on YouTube when selected.
Ask to open a webpage by name or give its HTTPS address. Named pages use current search results.
Repeated video searches reuse cached results without recording another paid search.
